name: QualityGate
description: Run your project's QualityGate Lighthouse and accessibility checks on the page you are looking at, through a local bridge on your own machine.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:*; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
